description: MainActivity.java is an Android Java source file that defines the MainActivity class, which extends a custom SampleActivityBase. It manages a RecyclerViewFragment, handles options menu interactions for toggling a log display, and initializes logging components including custom log wrappers, filters, and a log fragment.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages UI components including a RecyclerView, a log toggle, and logging setup.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that initializes the activity, setting the content view and adding the RecyclerViewFragment if launching for the first time.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from a resource.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the menu, updating the log toggle item visibility and title based on current state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item clicks, toggling the log display and updating UI accordingly.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up custom logging chain, including a LogWrapper, message filter, and log fragment for on-screen display.
